items.title: Ubuntu 26.10 Adds New Security Protection to curl, Blocking Revoked SSL Certificates
items.description: Ubuntu 26.10 Stonking Stingray adds certificate revocation checks to curl, helping the command-line tool reject HTTPS connections that use revoked certificates.
